name: effort-router
description: Sets the effort of each main-conversation turn from how demanding its prompt is, rated by Jev (through OpenRouter or TypeSafe) with Haiku as the fallback

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: OpenRouter key used to call Jev. Leave empty to use the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: TypeSafe key used to call Jev directly. Leave empty to use the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable.

jev_service.title: Preferred Jev service
jev_service.description: Which service calls Jev when keys for both are found

trivial_effort.title: Effort for trivial turns
trivial_effort.description: Acknowledgements, one-line answers, tiny mechanical edits

hard_effort.title: Effort for hard turns
hard_effort.description: Design, multi-file builds, cross-cutting changes, hard debugging

unsure_effort.title: Effort when unsure
unsure_effort.description: For a turn Jev is too unsure to rate, or no classifier answers. session keeps the session's own effort.

hard_threshold.title: Rate hard from (%)
hard_threshold.description: A turn counts as hard once Jev gives hard at least this chance

trivial_threshold.title: Rate trivial from (%)
trivial_threshold.description: A turn counts as trivial only once Jev gives trivial at least this chance
